changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS astral_weekly_progress ( account_id INT NOT NULL, week_start DATE NOT NULL, fragments_earned INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, boss_kills INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (account_id, week_start), CONSTRAINT fk_astral_weekly_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS astral_relics ( account_id INT NOT NULL, character_id INT NOT NULL, tier TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, forged_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (account_id), UNIQUE KEY uq_astral_relic_character (character_id), CONSTRAINT fk_astral_relic_account FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_astral_relic_character FOREIGN KEY (character_id) REFERENCES characters (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS astral_relics; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS astral_weekly_progress;
